steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Lancet-2, I have a serious question.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Isn't your battery running low?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh, don't worry about that. Before we left, the lovely Ms. Closure fitted me with a brand new, extra long-lasting battery.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Theoretically, I could function for a week without needing a charge.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: The aircraft is also carrying spare batteries, so you don't have to worry about me.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Now where did Kay run off to? On our way back, the kiddo suddenly hopped to her feet and jetted away.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: It's true, we should be concerned about Ceobe's condition, but considering her strength and constitution, we don't need to be too concerned.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Hah, I'm bored.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: We fixed up the aircraft, patched up the wounded Gavial sent over, and now we've got nothing to do.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: That we can't speak the local language is just a cherry on top. I should've gone to that ceremony with the Doctor.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: The aircraft is an important Rhodes Island asset, it's our responsibility to guard it well.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: I'm just saying. I mean, I'm a pilot, I know the deal with the aircraft.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: You're lucky, Lancet-2, you can just switch into sleep mode when you're bored. I was out for twelve hours yesterday, so I'm wide awake.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Well, actually, I have no ability to feel 'boredom'.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Although I do understand what this feeling is, Mr. Dylan. The lovely Ms. Closure complains about these things a lot. And it causes her to behave in strange ways.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: ...I think about this sometimes, Lancet-2, are we totally sure you and the other bots don't have a human crammed up in there anywhere?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: We don't. My interior is a precisely-designed circuitry construct. Do you want to see?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Although, since I have been programmed with a female personality, I may act out in unexpected ways when presenting my body to the opposite sex.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Err, I'll pass.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: If was going to see anything, I'd definitely prefer a swimsuit at a time like this.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: A swimsuit?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Yeah, it's summertime. That's when you put on a swimsuit and go play in the water.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: In that case, I'll play an audio recording of various sea sounds for you.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: No thanks, it'd only make me feel worse.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: ...Then maybe... Mr. Dylan would like to see me in a swimsuit?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Definitely not!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh, sorry. I am only a robot, after all.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Err, I'm the one who's sorry. I didn't mean it like that.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Don't worry about it. By the way, have you seen the sea, Mr. Dylan?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Um, I have. I'm thinking it was that time we loaned Master SilverAsh an aircraft last summer after a schedule change mixed things up. I flew him there.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: It turns out, the place was a major vacation spot. Master SilverAsh made me a VIP guest.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Man, that's when I realized how us poor folks could scarcely imagine what the rich live like.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Here, I've got the pictures with me.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: You long for this kind of life, Mr. Dylan?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Hm? I mean... that was a really great couple of days, but if my whole life was like that, I don't think I'd ever get used to it.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: I'm more of an instant-noodles-in-the-cockpit kind of guy. With an inverted sleep schedule to boot.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh you can't do that. Let me formulate a healthy lifestyle plan for you.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: No thanks, I'm good!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Too bad. The lovely Ms. Closure created this feature for me, but no one uses it. Not her, not the Doctor.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Haha, sounds about right.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Oh, but that reminds me, the tribes here live so much better than I thought. They really want for nothing.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Yes, life here is less convenient and comfortable than the world we know, but not to any significant degree.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: According to my records, your health has improved in the past two days.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Turns out returning to nature will do that for you. Heh. I guess this is the life that everyone came from.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Oh yeah, I just remembered, Gavial said something about a gigantic waterfall in the rainforest that way. I'd love to go there when the Doctor gets back.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: They may have already gone that way.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: The Doctor is a good boss. And I know our friends wouldn't abandon us to go play under the waterfall!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: True. Then let's wait patiently.
Is there a 'Dylan' here?

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: That's me!

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Huh? You speak Sargonian?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Yes. And you're here with the machine. Right, it must be you.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The one called 'Doctor' asked me to give you this note.

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: Hm? Let's see here...

steps.name: Dylan
steps.text: ...Lancet-2, looks like we've got work to do.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Wow! I could hear the roar of the water from so far away, I never knew waterfalls even got this big!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah, I didn't steer you wrong, did I?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Sure enough. I guess I'll forgive you~

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Haha! It really is an incredible waterfall.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like Tomimi isn't here yet, so let's take a little break.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hooray! I can finally get some use out of my swimsuit~

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You got a lotta fight in you, squirt.
Kemar, well aware of the language barrier, communicates with her stance, rather than words.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Heh. Seeing as I've got nothing else to do, we might as well go a few rounds.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Blaze is really going at it hard with that girl over there.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure is.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I don't see what's so fun about fighting.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: ...I heard you singin' a whole 'nother tune last time you was fightin', Utage.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Ahahaha. I guess you're right.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hey, Croissant, that isn't a swimsuit, is it?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ahahaha, ya got me. It's just some outdoorsy getup I snagged. Plenty waterproof, so we'n pretend it's a swimsuit.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You're a real function over form kinda girl, huh?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But hey, it may not be a beach, but playing around a waterfall is pretty great too! It's got that real 'back to nature' vibe. Too bad I didn't bring my camera.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya got that right. I ain't never been out in the wilds like this before. I'm havin' a ball!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whassat?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Am I seeing things?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Isn't that Kay?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How do you like the waterfall, Doctor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah, I used to love coming here to bathe.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like you've got a lot on your mind, Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're cruisin' for a bruisin', Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: From here it's just a short walk to Zumama's tribe.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: When I got that letter from Tomimi, I never thought things would turn out like this.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...Oh, Doctor, there's one thing that's been really gnawing at my brain these past few days. We're friends, right? I wanna ask you about it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Do you think...?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Doooctooor!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What's happening? I'm trying to talk to the Doctor here.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Look over there!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Is that... Kay?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I found it! The Mushroom Sea!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Bath time!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like she's still off in la la land.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But she's just so cute rolling around in the water like that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Gah, stupid kid.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How about we just let her play for a while...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Anyway, Doctor, what I wanted to ask was—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Do you think my tail's gotten fatter?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What? Really? I guess I'm going on a diet when we get back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come on, Doctor, don't look at me like that. An Archosauria's tail is her most prized asset! This is my life!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Pfft, I knew I shouldn't have asked you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You don't know, Tomimi's tail wasn't always that fat. And I don't want mine to end up like hers.

options: What do you think about Zumama?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? What do I think about her?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I guess I think she's real tough, and she can make a helluva machine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I had a feeling you'd be down with tails!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: There's Tomimi. You done with that thing?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hmmmmm?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You're a cutie! Gavial, I never knew you had a friend like this. I thought you just hung around with other muscleheaded lunks like you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That was uncalled for!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: She's got perfect skin, refined features, and a gothy outfit that really goes with her complexion.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Gothy? Is that in?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, no. But it's popular with a certain crowd.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I-I picked it up from a magazine. They said it's how they dress in the outside world.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, no, girl, honey. You've got a critically flawed understanding of fashion here. But that's okay. I mean, look at this place. I totally get why you'd come up with something like that.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But don't worry, you just let Big Sister Utage fill you with her bottomless, extra-thick fashion wisdom!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Gavial, I'm borrowing her!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wha? Whaaaaaaa?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sure, knock yourself out.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Anyway, we're all here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'll see if I can get Kay to sober up...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Break time's over! Kay is back in the fight!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gavial, she's makin' a break for it again!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Grr, everybody, get your clothes on! We're going after her!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That direction... it's the way to Zumama's tribe...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hold on! Did you really change that fast?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Wait up!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why bother changing? Just go!
